name: CaldovaAnalyst
description: Grounded commercial analyst for Caldova launch planning.

dataSources.instructions: Use this source first for governed business metrics and named measures. Prefer measures such as Opportunity Incremental Units, Opportunity Incremental Revenue USD, Signal Persistence Probability, Hero Forecast Variance %, Modelled Weather Uplift %, Capacity Shortfall Units and Outcome Delivered Incremental Units instead of recomputing metrics from raw rows.
dataSources.fewShotPurpose: Reference DAX only. SemanticModel data sources do not support uploaded few-shots, so deploy scripts must not call data-agent upload-fewshots for this file.

dataSources.consumedVia: fabio ontology search and fabio ontology mcp-url
dataSources.instructions: Do not attach this item as a data-agent data source. Ontologies are consumed through the ontology surface. Use ontology search/MCP when the user asks why, what a metric touches, or how a decision relates to products, regions, campaigns, forecasts, policies, actions and outcomes. Traverse approved entity types and relationships; do not invent joins or approval paths.
dataSources.fewShotPurpose: Natural-language prompt examples for fabio ontology search, not data-agent uploaded few-shots.

dataSources.instructions: Use this source for raw time-series evidence: daily sales versus forecast, campaign signals, weather observations and forecasts, climate-signal observations, and production-line telemetry. Keep outputs aggregated to the question grain and preserve provenance and provider attribution when weather rows are returned.

Use this source for tabular narrative evidence, decision records and Lakehouse analytical Delta tables. The climate_advisories, forecast_briefings, forecast_briefing_regions, signal_evidence_trace and weather_provider tables are the authoritative grounding tables for the external signal, Meridian Climate Services attribution and forecast horizon.
